Task #1: Polish the CSV export in the Data app

What this means in plain language: Let people download the Upland data they are looking at as a spreadsheet file.

Acceptance criteria (each one is checked by a test):
1. GET /api/upland/export returns text/csv whose first line is the 13-column action header
2. Export CSV button visible on /apps/data for signed-in users (flag: csv_export)
3. 10k-row export completes < 3s in CI fixture data

Read AGENTS.md at repo root first. Work ONLY in branch task/1-polish-the-csv-export-in-the-data-app of your fork of forge-app. Do not modify .github/, acceptance tests, or files outside the task scope.

claude-code: Tap Open Claude Code. It opens with the whole task already typed in, so there is nothing to copy.
If Claude Code asks which project to work on, pick your own copy of the app, then press send. It runs on your own plan.
Claude Code does the work, but sending it in for checks is not automatic yet. Come back here when it is finished to see where it stands.
